title: Thousands in UK open case against Johnson & Johnson over alleged talcum powder cancer link
summary: High court claim says company knowingly sold product containing asbestos and ‘concealed’ risk to public Thousands of people are taking legal action against pharmaceutical company Johnson & Johnson, claiming it knowingly sold asbestos-contaminated talcum powder in the UK. As many as 3,000 people have alleged that either they or a family member developed forms of ovarian cancer or mesothelioma from using Johnson’s Baby Powder, and are seeking damages at the high court in London.
